plainLanguage: Denton's rules could not be checked online during this research, so treat this entry as a placeholder. Denton zones land under the Denton Development Code, and you will need to tell us your lot's zoning district. Like the rest of North Texas, Denton has shifting clay soils, so plan on an engineer-designed slab. The city cannot require brick or stone on new homes, but your HOA may. Denton is in energy climate zone 3A. Fees and setbacks will be added once verified.
